Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 
CIRCULAR AUDIO CONNECTORS 



( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 



PART 2 SOCKET, FIVE CONTACTS, NONRIGID TYPE 12420 13-01 



0. General — This standard shall be read in conjunction with IS : 12420 ( Part 1 ) 'Specification 
for circular audio connectors: Part 1 Test Schedule and requirements'.

9, Material, Finish and Life — The material, finish and life requirement shall b^ as given below: 

a) l\/laterial 

Outer shell : Diecast alloy 
Dielectric : OAP/Rubber 

Contact : Be-Cu gold plated 

Mounting parts ; Brass 

b) Fini&h 

All shell and mounting parts to t^ finished to cadmium plate with olive drab chromatic 
finish. 

c) Mechanical : 1 600 mating cycles ^ a rate of 30 cycles/minute. 

4. Climatic Category 

a) Temperature severity : — SSito +86**C 

b) Damp heat severity : 56 days 

c) Air pressure severity : 8*5 kPa 

d) Acceleration ( steady state ) : 170 m/s? 

e) Vibration : 10 to 55 Hz 

f) Shock : 500 m/fi2

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is based on JSS 50831 ( Nov 1^72 ) 'Detail specificatiDn for connectors,
